Players may need to reduce distracting sounds so that they can focus on sounds that they need to hear. If your game has custom volume controls, players can adjust the relative levels of different types of sound, such as music, sound effects, ambient audio, and character speech. Directional Audio

Players may need to rely on audio cues to understand the locations of in-game objects. If your game has stereo sound, it conveys the relative position of a sound by the left and right channels. Adjustable Difficulty
Difficulty settings allow players to match their experience to their abilities and preferences.
Adjustable Text Size
Players can adjust text size, such as in-game text, menu text, character dialog text or subtitle text.
Camera Comfort
Players have an option to adjust or disable uncomfortable camera movement such as screen shaking, camera bob, or motion blur, or your game doesn't feature these effects.
Color Alternatives
Gameplay doesn't rely on colors to communicate important information, or players have an option to adjust colors used for distinguishing information.
Contrast Controls
Contrast is adjustable, such as by changing foreground and background colors, highlighting foreground elements, or enabling dark or light mode.
Custom Volume Controls
The volume for different types of in-game audio can be adjusted independently from each other.
Keyboard Only Option
Players can play the game with just a keyboard and no other additional input mechanisms such as a mouse or controller.
Mouse Only Option
Players can play the game with just a mouse and no other additional input mechanisms such as a keyboard or controller.
Narrated Game Menus
Players can listen to game menus with narrated audio.
Playable at Your Own Pace
Players can take as long as they need for any input, or inputs that require specific timing can be disabled or skipped.
Playable without Vision

Players can play the game fully without ever being able to see the screen. Either your game is designed around gameplay that doesn't require vision (e.g. sound), or your support for screen readers or narration is complete enough to experience the entire game.
Save Anytime
Players can save gameplay using both automatic and manual saves, and saving can be performed at any point in the game. Players can look for this tag to know that they won't lose significant progress.
Chat Speech-to-text
Voice chat between players can be read as a text transcript in real time.
Stereo Sound
Players can identify how far to the left or right sounds are coming from.
Subtitle Options

Players have options to customize the display of subtitles for all spoken content and essential audio information. Basic subtitle support can be insufficient for players with impaired vision. Providing options for background opacity, text color and size can allow players to customize subtitles for their comfort.
Surround Sound
Players can identify how far in any direction sounds are coming from.
Chat Text-to-speech
Text chat between players can be narrated out loud in real time.
Touch Only Option
Players can play the game with just touch controls and no other additional input mechanisms such as a mouse, keyboard or controller.
Playable without Quick Time Events
Players can avoid sequences of precisely timed inputs ("quick time events") or button mashing.

AssetRequest_MM_Update_Design3: Do not include any additional text in this image. Information about the event update and call-to-action will automatically appear alongside the image.

AssetRequest_Requirements_2: Artwork must be in layered Photoshop (PSD) files
AssetRequest_Requirements_2a: Main game/character art in highest resolution possible (smart object preferred). Doing so allows us to re-use these assets to create other Steam promotional art when necessary.
AssetRequest_Requirements_2b: Logo (smart object preferred) separated from the art.
AssetRequest_Requirements_2c: Any text should be editable in a separate “text” folder within the PSD document, so that it may be easily localized by our team.
AssetRequest_Requirements_3: Include any fonts used (especially custom fonts).
AssetRequest_Requirements_3point5: Please keep all text styling and layers within Photoshop. Do not link to files from other programs, such as Illustrator.
AssetRequest_Requirements_4: For animated assets, please also provide a seamless looping MP4 or PNG sequence without the text and logo. Make sure that any text is on a separate layer and not animated so it may be easily localized by our team.
AssetRequest_Requirements_5: For more details and examples, plus specifics for animated assets, please see <1>Store Promo Graphical Assets</1>
